full_text:
ADDENDUM <No. 1040, March 18, 2024>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.

Article 2 (Validity Period) These Rules shall remain effective for five years from the date of their promulgation.

Article 3 (Applicability to Goods Subject to Anti-Dumping Measures during Reexamination) These Rules shall apply to goods for which import declarations were filed on or after July 22, 2023.
